item.title: Indiana eyes toll bonds and a P3 for $6.5 billion I-70 project
item.description: The state says the $6.5 billion project is not possible without toll revenue.

item.title: Munis sell off in belly of the curve as blocks trade at wider levels
item.description: "There was a certain amount of resilience munis had in the last week, comfortable enough with distribution," said Kim Olsan, senior fixed income portfolio manager at NewSquare Capital Markets. "But the 10-year Treasury backing up behind 4.20%, it proved to be the catalyst for adjusted bid-sides."

item.title: Moody's lowers New York City's rating outlook to negative
item.description: The Aa2 rating was affirmed, but the negative outlook could raise the stakes as New York lawmakers debate the city's budget gap.

item.title: Growing FEMA problems said to pressure states and localities
item.description: FEMA must speed its very slow disbursement of aid, many observers say.

item.title: Chicago pulls tax-exempt part of bond deal
item.description: Chicago postponed the sale of about $292 million of tax-exempt bonds from an $800 million general obligation bond deal.

item.title: With active security selection, airport bonds can add ballast as geopolitics rattle markets
item.description: Market Intelligence analyst Jeff Lipton assigns a stable yet guarded view to airport bonds, highlighting how gateways and large hubs can outperform as fuel costs, travel demand and geopolitical risk evolve — while investors sharpen focus on leverage, rate recovery and cyber defenses.

item.title: ULM Properties' student housing bonds downgraded to B3 by Moody's
item.description: The rating agency cited weak demand for the facilities.

item.title: Austin City Council OKs up to $575 million of water system bonds
item.description: The Texas city's bond issue will mostly refinance short-term commercial paper into long-term debt and refund some callable Series 2015 bonds.

item.title: IRS clearing up arbitrage rules
item.description: The Internal Revenue Service is proposing rule changes regarding the complex relationship between tax-exempt bonds, arbitrage and State and Local Government Series Securities.

item.title: Munis extend selloff but asset class remains 'resilient'
item.description: The March/April period is typically a softer period for the muni market, said Jeff Timlin, managing partner and head of municipal bond investing at Sage Advisory.
